selected_evidence.requirement: node1 /dev/shm mounted with noexec,nosuid,nodev, persisted in fstab
selected_evidence.summary: Playbook task added noexec to /dev/shm's existing tmpfs mount and wrote an fstab entry; findmnt and /etc/fstab both show rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec

selected_evidence.requirement: Execution, setuid, and device nodes are ignored on both mounts (functional proof, not just mount flags)
selected_evidence.summary: Live test on node1: a chmod +x script in /tmp and /dev/shm both fail with Permission denied (exit 126); a setuid-root binary copied to /tmp loses privilege on exec; mknod-created char device in /tmp cannot be read (Permission denied)

node2 (ansible-core 2.20 + ansible.posix collection) used as control node; ansible -m ping and ansible-playbook runs against inventory targeting node1 show the ansible.posix.mount-based playbook applying and later confirming (changed=0) the hardened state
